meta.services.title: Services · Pomelo STEM
meta.services.description: Websites, shop systems and automation for growing businesses in Singapore and Malaysia.
services.h1: Websites, shop systems and automation for growing businesses.
services.lead: We start from how your business runs today and build only what makes that easier.
svc.commerce.title: Online shop and PWA
svc.commerce.body: A fast shop site on your own domain that works on phones and installs like an app.
svc.software.title: Custom software
svc.software.body: Focused tools for stock, quotes or scheduling when a spreadsheet has become a risk.
svc.software.d2: A small first release in weeks
svc.ai.title: AI & automation
svc.ai.body: Repetitive writing and data entry handed to the assistant you choose, connected through MCP.
svc.ai.d3: Clear limits on what is automated
svc.commerce.fit: Shops moving orders off chat and spreadsheets.
svc.software.fit: Teams with one process that eats hours every week.
svc.ai.fit: Businesses that write the same things again and again.
process.title: Small steps you can see and test.
process.1.title: Discover
process.1.body: We sit with you and map how work happens today.
process.2.title: Plan
process.2.body: We agree on the smallest release that helps.
process.3.title: Build & test
process.3.body: You try a working version every two weeks.
process.4.title: Improve
process.4.body: We adjust from real use, not guesses.
process.alt: A desk at dusk with a brass lamp, a closed laptop and a sketchbook of wireframes.
faq.title: A few good questions.
faq.1.q: Do I own my shop's domain and data?
faq.1.a: Yes. The shop runs on your domain, and you can export your products and orders.
faq.2.q: Which AI does Pomelo STEM use?
faq.2.a: None of its own. You connect the assistant you already use through MCP, and a person reviews every result.
faq.3.a: That's the usual way. Most projects begin with one shop or one workflow.
meta.about.title: About · Pomelo STEM
meta.about.description: Why Pomelo STEM builds practical software with small businesses in Singapore and Malaysia.
about.h1: We build with shop owners, not for them.
about.philosophy: Technology should adapt to businesses, not force businesses to adapt to technology.
about.alt: A developer and a shop owner sketch a shop layout together at a wooden table.
about.pomelo.title: Why a pomelo
about.pomelo.body: A pomelo starts small and grows into something whole, with every segment connected. We build software the same way: start with what you need today, and let it grow with you.
about.stem.title: Why STEM
about.stem.body: Science, technology, engineering and mathematics: the practical skills behind every tool we make.
about.p1: We show you a working version every two weeks.
about.p2: We explain choices in plain words.
about.p3: We build the smallest thing that helps first.
about.p4: You keep your data and your domain.
